summary: Independent design review approves the frozen bounded implementation specification after recomputing the exact native design context and validating the supplied context. The smallest integration is one isolated opt-in module and an exactly pinned optional SDK dependency; the existing AI Flow CLI, native review and feedback readers, Schema and Policy remain unchanged. The fixed Git-blob manifest, explicit document and question selection, candidate binding, UTF-8/path/object/size checks and application-bound result metadata address the actual one-shot document-review need without a generic provider layer or scheduler. Offline preparation must not import or construct the SDK, while explicit execution reserves a fresh ignored output location and cannot replay an uncertain attempt. The installed SDK 0.163.0 was independently inspected: its public typed request transport has no request deadline, generated ThreadStartResponse does not retain activePermissionProfile, disabledPluginIds explicitly does not filter plugin capabilities, and SDK close/interrupt alone cannot prove remote completion. The specification correctly requires bounded lifecycle supervision, effective configuration and full thread receipt checks, an exact named root-deny/input-read profile with no additional grants or network, explicit approval refusal, and real synthetic read/write/outside-read canaries before a model turn. Retaining harmless built-ins is consistent with the SDK and avoids an unsupported zero-tools claim. Intentionally selected inherited global instructions require a separately declared expected hash; other sources fail closed, and unexposed internal model context remains unknown. Companion usage documentation must explain this planned hash-based inherited-instruction path when implemented. The existing ChatGPT-login/subscription choice does not authorize credential copying, API-key billing, purchases or broader Desktop attachment. The client timeout is not a monetary cap or proof of upstream stop; cancellation request, confirmed final interruption and unknown result remain distinct, with no retry. Small validated outcome/summary/findings output and original candidate locations can be projected into the existing real PR feedback format without fabricating GitHub native reviews, independent truth or model identity. The docs-only real development candidate is engineering acceptance rather than a research sample. Real execution and feedback readback remain required goal steps; offline V1 or this design approval cannot complete that goal. Required native V1, independent implementation review, Gate and required CI remain intact. Real scoring, automatic arrangement, T0/T1, existing Desktop attachment and cross-repository initialization remain outside this implementation. No open blocking design findings remain.
